propositions: Project code-review criteria were dropped at five seam points: criterion-id resolver, Round-A fan-in, Pass-3 routing, eval/calibration admission, and CLI admission.
The extension contract for project code-review criteria is undocumented and unproven in deployed Gerrit review bot operations.
Project code-review criteria must be threaded through the full four-pass system while preserving 13 built-in packaged criteria and default resolver mappings.
Project criteria must execute once in Round A, retain logical criteria id and physical reviewer_id, and use repository-effective Pass-3 routing decisions.
The eval/calibration API and CLI must admit active project code-review criteria while rejecting inactive or ambiguous project identifiers.
Live dogfood in production Gerrit reviews must demonstrate project criteria functioning with advisory-only posture, merged changes, and clean coverage telemetry.
